title: School rugby training workload

source.citation: Hu X, Boisbluche S, Philippe K, Maurelli O, Ren X, Li S, et al. (2024) Position-specific workload of professional rugby union players during tactical periodization training. PLoS ONE 19(3): e0288345.

what_is_measured.description: Session duration, from warm-up to the last drill.
Average speed. Multiplied by duration_min, this is within a few metres of total distance.
Maximum deceleration. Negative means slowing down.
Distance covered above 21 km/h (very high-speed running).

reconstruction: The published CSV has no player id. Rows are grouped by training model, position (1 = forward, 2 = back), acquisition day (1 = strength, 2 = endurance, 3 = speed), then player, then week 1 to 5. The same 15 forwards and 11 backs appear in the same order in every block, so PLAYER_01 to PLAYER_26 stay stable. That player identity is reconstructed from the file order. It was not published by the researchers.

calendar.training_model_1: Specific endurance. Five weeks from Monday 1 February 2027. Strength Monday, endurance Wednesday, speed Thursday.
calendar.training_model_2: Specific speed. Five weeks from Monday 12 April 2027. Strength Monday, endurance Tuesday, speed Thursday.
